Problem 18[edit]

  • (iii) Empty the L bottle.
  • (iv) Pour water from the L bottle into the L bottle until the L bottle is full or the L bottle is empty, whichever happens first. If the L bottle fills, empty the L bottle and return to the beginning of this step.

Lavinia completes this sequence of four steps in this order a total of times. Lavinia never spills any water. How much water will be in the bottle after Lavinia is finished?
